newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chaifa places 15 mln shrs at HK$2.35.
newsitem.headline: Chaifa places 15 mln shrs at HK$2.35.

text.p: Controlling shareholder Chan C.T. Investments International Ltd has agreed to place 15 million existing shares, or 5.61 percent, of Chaifa Holdings Ltd's share capital at HK$2.35 per share, Chaifa said in a statement on Tuesday.

Chan C.T. Investments, owned by members of Chaifa's chairman Chan Chun-tung's family, has also agreed to subscribe 23 million new shares, or 7.92 percent of the enlarged share capital, at the same price.
Shares of the company, which manufactures and distributes Playboy-brand goods, ended at HK$2.40 per share on Monday.
DBS Securities Hong Kong Ltd is the placing agent.
On completion of the deal on September 17, the aggregate shareholding of Chan C.T. Invesmtents and chairman Chan Chun- tung will be diluted to 35.04 percent from 35.07 percent.

Some HK$30 million of the HK$53.5 million proceeds will be used to reduce bank borrowings, about HK$15 million will fund marketing activities in China and the remaining will be used for working capital, the company said.
